column1: # Exact content-and-finding ratchet for Kubernetes manifests extracted from KRO RGDs.
# Columns: count, repository-relative RGD path, evidence ID, severity/type, line range/digest.
# This is not an ignore file: scan-rgd-templates.sh runs every Trivy misconfiguration check without
# exclusions, then fails on any difference from these visible findings or the extracted-content
# digests. The digests preserve value-sensitive cause evidence that an ID/count/range projection
# loses. A finding removed from the templates must be removed here in the same change; a new finding
# Measured with Trivy v0.74.0 and the policies embedded in that binary. Pull-request CI pins the
# binary; scan-rgd-templates.sh rejects any other version and disables independent policy updates.
